Educator Profile & Overview

Welcome to Primary Science Studio

Hello! I am Liew Chui Yee. This studio serves as a dedicated primary science curriculum mapping and pedagogical scaffolding studio. It is designed to streamline lesson planning, inquiry-based science process skills, and performance level (PL 1–6) classroom assessments.
